plugin.name: N.E.K.O RimWorld
plugin.description: Read your colony, get advice, and revisit full answers and discussions. No game commands are issued.
panel.subtitle: Advice and past discussions
panel.refreshErrorHelp: Your last view is still available. Try refreshing shortly; this won't start another consultation.
connection.pairingNeeded: Pair your game to get started
setup.title: Get started with RimWorld advice
setup.readyTitle: You're ready to ask a question
setup.intro: Follow these steps, then ask about your colony in your N.E.K.O conversation.
setup.pair: Enable N.E.K.O Bridge in the game's Mod Settings, generate a pairing code, then enter the same port and code in this panel's settings.
setup.paired: Pairing details are saved. Enable Bridge in the game with the same port and pairing code.
setup.load: Keep the game running and load your colony. You can ask questions while the game is paused.
setup.model: Enter your model service URL, model name, and any required API key in Settings. The default limits are enough to get started.
setup.configured: The model service is configured. Its availability is checked when you ask a question.
setup.ask: Return to your N.E.K.O conversation and ask, “In RimWorld, what should I deal with first?” The full answer will be saved here.
setup.modelNotice: Consultations use your configured model service and send it relevant game information; charges may apply. Viewing history and checking the game connection do not call a model.
advice.readErrorHelp: Your previous view is still available. Refresh saved answers to try again; the game won't be queried again.
advice.waitHelp: You can switch pages while this continues. Any earlier advice below belongs to the previous discussion and will update when this finishes. Stopping or reloading the plugin interrupts consultations.
advice.empty: No discussions for this colony yet
advice.continue: Continue in your N.E.K.O conversation. Refreshing or reading saved answers won't start a consultation or issue game commands.
progress.retrying: The model hasn't responded yet; trying again
answer.currentHistory: Current colony · This advice reflects the game when you asked, not any later changes.
answer.otherHistory: Past discussion · This advice reflects an earlier game state.
answer.saving: The analysis is still running; this record isn't complete yet.
answer.saveUnconfirmed: Saving this result hasn't been confirmed. Copy the full answer for now; you don't need to repeat the consultation just to keep it.
answer.draft: This answer is incomplete and may not cover everything you asked.
answer.empty: No answer was saved for this consultation
answer.fullOnly: Only the full answer is available. You can read it below.
answer.exportUnavailable: The answer is retained, but a downloadable file isn't available. You can still read or copy the full text.
answer.copyError: Couldn't copy the answer. Expand it and select the text to copy it manually.
failure.worldChanged: The game connection or loaded save changed during the consultation. Check your current colony before asking again.
failure.configureModel: Set up a model service in Settings before asking a question.
failure.timeout: This consultation didn't finish in time. You can read any retained content and try again later.
failure.outputLimit: The model reached its output limit before finishing. You can review that limit in advanced settings.
failure.modVersion: The game Mod and plugin don't support the same reading capabilities. Check the versions listed in the installation guide.
failure.incomplete: This consultation didn't finish. Any available content is retained; troubleshooting details may explain what happened.
failure.cancelled: This consultation was interrupted. Saved content is still available.
failure.retained: Reading or copying won't call the model again. Return to your N.E.K.O conversation if you'd like to ask again.
history.offline: You can browse saved discussions while the game is offline.
history.readErrorHelp: Your previous view is still available. Refresh saved answers to try again; no new consultation will start.
history.search: Find a question or conversation character
history.searchHelp: Search all saved questions. Results are grouped by character and colony.
history.searchPlaceholder: Enter words from a question or a character name
history.noMatches: No matching discussions. Try different words or select all colonies.
history.empty: No discussions yet. Ask a RimWorld question in your N.E.K.O conversation to save one here.
history.noQuestions: There are no questions in this discussion yet.
history.question: Question
history.continueHelp: To continue a discussion, return to the same character's N.E.K.O conversation and mention the question or people involved. Nothing new is submitted from this page.
settings.intro: Connect the game and set up your model service. Saving settings does not call a model.
settings.pairHelp: Enable N.E.K.O Bridge in RimWorld's Mod Settings. Use the same port and pairing code on both sides. If you generate a new code, update it here too.
settings.keepToken: Already configured. Leave blank to keep it; the field clears after saving is confirmed.
settings.needToken: Paste the pairing code generated in the game's Mod Settings.
settings.modelHelp: This model is used only for RimWorld consultations; it doesn't inherit N.E.K.O's character model settings. Saved changes apply to your next question. Saving does not test the service.
settings.urlHelp: Use the OpenAI-compatible API URL supplied by your provider.
settings.keepKey: Already configured. Leave blank to keep it; the saved key is never sent back to this page.
settings.needKey: Local models may not need a key; remote services usually do.
settings.budgetHelp: The defaults usually work well. Times are in seconds. The token limit may include reasoning and must be supported by your provider. These limits are saved with the model settings.
settings.retryHelp: Temporary failures can be retried up to 3 attempts before useful output begins. Retries count toward time and usage.
settings.draftHelp: Drafts stay when switching pages within this panel. Closing or reloading discards unsaved input; key drafts are never stored in the browser. If saving is unconfirmed, check its status before saving again.
settings.invalidBridge: Use a whole-number port from 1 to 65535. For first-time pairing, paste the 32–128 character code generated by the game.
settings.invalidModel: Enter a service URL and model name.
settings.integerTokens: The output token limit must be a whole number.
settings.budget.finalization_reserve_sec: Time reserved to finish the answer
settings.save.saving: Saving your settings and checking the result.
settings.save.saved: Settings saved and applied for your next consultation.
settings.save.failed: These settings weren't applied. Review the information below before trying again.
settings.save.unconfirmed: Saving hasn't been confirmed. The changes may already have been written.
settings.save.unconfirmedHelp: Review the current settings and check the save status first. The previous save record may be unavailable after the plugin restarts. Confirm what is in use before saving again. No write will be repeated automatically.
settings.save.failedHelp: Review the port, pairing code, or model settings. More information is available in Troubleshooting.
settings.error.ui_only: The panel state has changed. Refresh it before saving again.
settings.error.invalid_agent_settings: Check the model URL, name, and advanced limits.
settings.error.bridge_start_error: Couldn't start the connection on this port. Check whether another app is using it.
settings.error.pairing_token_required: Enter the pairing code generated in the game.
settings.error.settings_busy: Another save is still running. Check its status first.
debug.displayError: Something went wrong displaying the panel
debug.unavailable: This action isn't available yet. Start the plugin and refresh the panel.
debug.selectionMismatch: The returned run doesn't match your selection. Refresh this view.
debug.reportMismatch: The returned report doesn't match your selection. Refresh this view.
debug.workMismatch: The returned record doesn't match your selection. Refresh this view.
debug.turnMismatch: The returned discussion doesn't match your selection. Refresh this view.
debug.readingMismatch: The saved reading doesn't match your selection. Refresh this view.
debug.sampleQuestion: How is my colony doing right now?
debug.consultIncomplete: The consultation didn't finish. Open its details for more information.
debug.question: Question
debug.testHelp: Use this to check consultation behavior from the panel. It calls your configured model and may incur charges. Switching pages won't cancel it or submit it again.
debug.testWait: You can switch pages while it runs. View the latest run for more detail.
debug.connectionTestHelp: Read a brief colony overview to check the Mod connection. This doesn't call a model.
debug.draftRetained: An incomplete draft is saved. It wasn't delivered as a completed answer.
debug.noResultHelp: The consultation may still be running or may have stopped before answering. You can check its events and model requests.
debug.incompleteResult: This consultation didn't finish. Any text returned is retained below, but may be incomplete.
debug.reportSaveWarning: Saving this report hasn't been confirmed. Copy the answer now; reloading may clear the temporary run record.
debug.noConnectionEvents: No connection events match this filter.
debug.detailsRetained: The previous view is still available. Tracking continues, and your selection won't change automatically.
debug.observationScope: Each reading keeps its own target, time, coverage, and returned data. Readings from different times are shown separately.
debug.noObservations: No final set of readings yet
debug.noObservationsHelp: While a consultation runs, completed reads are available in its events.
debug.noEvents: No events on this page match the filter.
debug.lightweightProgress: Only brief progress is refreshed while this runs. Full details load when it ends; you can also load them manually.
debug.outputLimitHelp: The model reached its output token limit before finishing. Reasoning may use part of that allowance.
debug.overloadTimeoutHelp: The provider was busy on repeated attempts. The last attempt timed out before the consultation could finish.
debug.overloadHelp: The provider is busy or temporarily unavailable.
debug.timeoutHelp: The provider didn't return a complete response within the available time.
debug.noModelResponse: The model service didn't return a usable response.
debug.outputLimitAction: Review the output limit in Settings before trying again. You don't need to restart RimWorld.
debug.overloadAction: Try again later or use a different service. You don't need to restart RimWorld.
debug.timeoutAction: Check the service response time or review the consultation time limit before trying again.
debug.modelFailureAction: Check the model name, service URL, and provider availability for this error.
debug.noRetry: No further automatic attempt was made, either because of the error or the time remaining.
debug.noReadsBeforeFailure: The model failed before any usable game readings were obtained.
debug.eventHelp: View request stages, inputs, outputs, and readings. Hidden reasoning and credentials aren't displayed.
debug.usageIncomplete: Usage is incomplete. “+ ?” marks a known subtotal; timed-out or cancelled requests may also have used tokens.
debug.setupWarning: The connection or model setup is incomplete. Finish it in Settings.
debug.noHandoff: No final short answer has been returned yet.
debug.noRunHistoryHelp: Ask in your N.E.K.O conversation, or use the consultation test here.
debug.reportRetention: Full reports and incomplete drafts survive plugin reloads. Up to 100 recent reports are kept separately from discussion history.
debug.noReports: No reports have been saved yet.
debug.historicalReport: This is a past report and may not reflect the current game.
debug.draftReport: This saved draft is incomplete. It wasn't delivered as a completed answer.
debug.askReport: Try a question about this report
debug.evidenceOmitted: The original readings exceeded the storage limit. The answer and sample references are retained, but the original readings aren't.
debug.savedReadingsHelp: These game readings were saved during the analysis. Viewing them doesn't query the game again.
debug.chooseDiscussionHelp: Choose a discussion from Latest advice or History first.
debug.historySaveUnknown: Saving this discussion hasn't been confirmed. Available records are shown below.
debug.noSavedReadings: No original game readings were retained for this discussion.
debug.preparedNotReceived: Prepared for delivery doesn't confirm it was received in the conversation.
debug.reportUnavailable: The separate report isn't available, but the original answer remains in the discussion.
debug.retries: Retried {count} times without a final answer.
debug.retainedReads: {count} game readings are retained, but the model didn't produce a final answer.
debug.runRetention: Shows up to {count} recent completed runs and any active runs. This temporary list clears when the plugin reloads.
debug.eventPage: Events {from}–{to} of {total}, in order of occurrence.
debug.reportReference: This question references report {id}. New reads keep their own sampling times.
debug.reportRequest: Please analyze the saved historical report {id}.
debug.reportReadings: The consultation included {count} readings, each with its own sampling information.
debug.usageHistory: {runs} recent runs: {requests} model requests, {tokens} known tokens. Up to {limit} completed runs are retained until the plugin reloads.
reading.read_situation: Situation overview: alerts, quests, and recent events
settings.save.savedWithDraft: Your previous changes were saved. The new edits shown here are still unsaved.
